Attack Vector: Exploitation of software vulnerabilities in Jira (CVE-2019-11581) and Exim (CVE-2019-10149) allowing remote code execution and command execution as root
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious payload undetected on VirusTotal with AV detection ratio 0/55
